title: pyrus keenanii
intro: Pyrus keenanii, commonly known as Wild Pear, is a species of deciduous tree native to Australia. The health benefits of Pyrus keenanii include its potential to support digestive health and provide antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus keenanii include its use as a laxative and its potential to support the treatment of gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus keenanii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other phytochemicals that may contribute to its medicinal properties.
